# Board Fixtures

Manual QA boards for `packages/lexera-kanban`.

Files:
- `hierarchy-depth.md`: row/stack/column/card hierarchy stress test
- `multi-row-scroll.md`: many rows for lower-row spacing and separators
- `dashboard-deadlines.md`: dashboard query, deadlines, overdue, and parked states
- `tag-style-and-layout.md`: numeric tags, header/footer tags, and layout-related labels
- `embed-matrix.md`: local file embeds, include directives, and asset-path interactions
- `wide-overflow.md`: wide rows and long column headers for overflow checks

All fixtures use the board markdown format and are safe to load manually into a test workspace.
